title: Account Request
description: A buyer agent's request to open or change an advertiser account, and its lifecycle (experimental, account.requests). The request is its own object: no account exists until the request resolves, so a seller can match the request to an existing account without changing an account_id. Requests are scoped to the authenticated caller that made them and are never visible to another caller.

request_id.description: Seller-assigned identifier for this request. Stable for the life of the request. It is not an account_id and is never accepted as an AccountRef.

requested.title: Requested Account
requested.description: Echo of what was requested: for an open, the brand, operator, and attributes; for a change, the account_id and the requested changes. When a repeat request replaced an open request's terms or changes, this shows the replacement. Never echoes billing_entity bank details or other write-only fields.

account_id.description: Present when the request named an existing account.

revision.description: The revision a change request was based on, when sent.

pending_action.description: Present when state is in_review. Says whose turn it is and what is needed.

account_id.description: Present when state is resolved. The account to use on every account-scoped task. Never changes for the life of the account. On a change request that resolves as created or matched, this is a different account from requested.account_id, and the named account is unchanged.

account.description: Present when state is resolved: the account after the request, including any changed attributes and its revision. Sellers SHOULD include it when resolution is updated, and MAY omit it otherwise.

resolution.description: Present when state is resolved: whether the seller matched an existing account, created one, or updated the named account. A change request can resolve as any of the three.

candidates.description: Present when state is ambiguous. Accounts that match the request, limited to accounts the caller is already granted. The seller MUST NOT list accounts the caller cannot already reach. When the only matches are outside the caller's grants, every caller-visible state, pending-action kind, and error MUST be one the seller could also return when nothing matches.

errors.description: Present when state is rejected. Why the seller declined, or that a buyer action expired.

created_at.description: When the seller recorded the request.

updated_at.description: When the request last changed state, pending action, or requested terms.

pending_action.message: Checking for an existing Renault France relationship.
